root_cause: loose terminal connector at junction box J-301
lessons_learned: Burst-pattern dropouts with 2 to 4 consecutive null readings indicate a physical connection problem not a bearing fault. Terminal tightening torque must be 5 to 6 Nm using calibrated torque screwdriver. Hand-tightening is the root cause of recurring faults. LOTO permit must be current before any work - expired permit caused 1 day delay on bottleneck asset.
